captions.ig:
A quote with no surprises is easier to say yes to. 5 Claude prompts to write one.

1. Turn your job notes into one line per item, then the total.
2. Add a short Not included list.
3. Give the price an end date. Many shops use 14 to 30 days.
4. Spell out the deposit, when the rest is due and how to pay.
5. Have Claude read it as the customer and fix every line they would ask about.

Sample business shown is made up.

Comment AGENTS and we will DM you the free Front Desk Starter: replies to customers in your voice. It drafts, you send.

Sources: Joblogic, Zigaflow, Arrivy.
